approach: Check how diff.external affects git diff invocation and add `--no-ext-diff` flag when external is set to ensure diffs work correctly with external diff tools configured.
hypothesis: When diff.external is configured, the code attempts to run `git diff` externally without `--no-ext-diff`, causing the diff to silently return empty results when comparing index/working tree since git treats external diff tools as requiring `--no-ext-diff`.
